senses.gloss: (b. h.; עָדַן)dainties, sweets; מַעֲדַנֵּי עולם the best things in the world.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 7:4">Num. R. s. 7</cite> <he>כל מ׳ ע׳ טועמין במן</he> they found in the manna the taste of all the best things &c.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 6:1:17">Y. Ber. VI, 10ᵇ</cite> top <he>בורא מיני מ׳</he> the Creator of various kinds of sweet things (fruits &c.).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 6:1:17">Ib.</cite> <he>על הארץ ועל מַעֲדַנֶּיהָ</he> for the land (Palestine) and its good things.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 67:2">Gen. R. s. 67</cite> <he>טעם כל מ׳ שבעולם</he> the taste of all good things in the world; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 115:19">Yalk. ib. 115</cite> <cite ref="M02180"><he>מערכים</he></cite> (corr. acc.); a. fr.
